verdict.rationale: Orb's docs show hybrid fixed-fee/seat plus usage pricing, prepaid credits with free allotments and auto top-ups, minimums and maximums that work like commitments, and plans configurable from the UI with per-customer overrides. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents tiered, volume, graduated, or per-unit price models. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit pricing models, explicit overage-on-commitment configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
